fullContentHtml:
RBI Officer Grade B Final Result 2026 – Full Details

Reserve Bank of India (RBI) has released the Final Result for the post of Officer Grade B (DR)- General, DEPR, DSIM. This recruitment was released for 60 posts. Applications for the RBI Officer Grade B Recruitment 2026 were accepted from April 29, 2026, to May 20, 2026. The Phase-II examination was conducted on 25-26 July 2026. Candidates who had appeared for this examination can download their RBI Officer Grade B (General) Final Result 2026 from the link given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 29 April 2026
  • Last Date : 20 May 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 20 May 2026
  • Correction Date : 25-26 May 2026
  • Phase I Exam Date : 13 June 2026 (DR General)
  • Phase I Exam Date : 14 June 2026 (DEPR/ DSIM)
  • Phase I Admit Card : 05 June 2026
  • Phase-I Result (General) : 25 June 2026
  • Phase 1 Result (DEPR) : 30 June 2026
  • Marks, Cutoff : 13 July 2026
  • Phase II Exam Date : 25 July 2026 (DR General)
  • Phase II Exam Date : 26 July 2026 (DEPR/ DSIM)

Application Fee

  • General, EWS, OBC : Rs. 850/-
  • SC, ST, PH : Rs. 100/-

How to Check Result

  1. Click on the direct official result link provided below.
  2. Enter your Roll Number / Registration Number and Date of Birth.
  3. Submit the form to view your scorecard on screen.
  4. Download and print a copy of the result for future reference.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

What is RBI Officer Grade B Final Result 2026?

RBI Officer Grade B Final Result 2026 is the official result announcement. Candidates can check their scorecard and merit status via the direct link above.

All verified official links are available in the Important Links table above on this page.
